shortDescription: Manage license activation and deactivation of BIG-IP Next instances.

options.name: jwt
options.description: The json web token to be used for license activation. Required when C(jwt_type) is set to C(new).

options.name: jwt_name
options.description: The name of the json web token to be used for license activation. Required when C(state) is set to C(activate).

options.name: jwt_type
options.description: This tells whether to create and use a new jwt or use an existing one.

options.name: next_ips
options.description: The IP addresses of the BIG-IP Next instances that are to be activated or deactivated.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the license to be set.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The time in seconds to wait for the license activation or deactivation to complete. The accepted value range is between C(150) and C(3600) seconds.
